lyrics:
[Intro: bright guitar riff, handclaps]

[Verse 1: easygoing male voice]
She's fifteen with her feet on my dash
One earbud in, one eye on the gas
I had the oldies station on, the good stuff, the real
She said, "Dad. I'm begging you. Let me have the wheel."

[Pre-Chorus: band lifts]
I said, "The steering wheel?" She said, "No. The sound."
I rolled my eyes and I handed it down

[Chorus: big, bouncy, singalong]
"Hand me the aux, Dad, hand me the cord
I'll play you something you ain't heard before"
First one I hated, second was fine
Third one, Lord help me, I knew every line
Now I'm the one saying, "Hey, what's that called?"
Hand me the... no. You keep the aux.

[Verse 2: voice warmer]
Now Friday nights we just drive, no place to be
She plays me hers, then one for me
She knows three songs by my favorite band
I know a girl with green hair who sings about a van

[Chorus: big, bouncy, singalong]
"Hand me the aux, Dad, hand me the cord
I'll play you something you ain't heard before"
First one I hated, second was fine
Third one, Lord help me, I knew every line
Now I'm the one saying, "Hey, what's that called?"
Hand me the... no. You keep the aux.

[Bridge: half-time, guitar and voice]
Three more years and that seat's gonna be bare
I'm learning every word while she's still there

[Final Chorus: full band, a girl's voice sings along]
"Hand me the aux, Dad, hand me the cord
I'll play you something you ain't heard before"
First one I hated, second was fine
Third one, Lord help me, I knew every line
Now I'm the one saying, "Run that one back"
You keep the aux. I like it like that.

[Outro: guitar riff, spoken]
Dad, you're singing.
Am not.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 100 BPM, 4/4, G major. Bright, bouncy and warm, a windows-down mid-tempo.

VOICE: Male, friendly mid-range with a Georgia-style drawl, half-laughing at himself. He quotes his daughter's lines in a lighter tone. A teenage girl's voice joins the last chorus and speaks in the outro.

INSTRUMENTS: A bright, clean electric guitar riff, strummed acoustic guitar, handclaps, punchy live drums, bass, banjo rolling in the choruses, a little synth pad.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro riff. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Pre-chorus. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:36 Chorus 2. 2:04 Bridge, half-time. 2:20 Final chorus with her voice. 2:50 Outro riff and two spoken lines, ends 3:06.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s radio country: bright, tight, loud choruses, everything polished.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Hand me the... no. You keep the aux.' at 1:08.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young man winning a girl with a song. This is a father letting his daughter change the music, and finding that is how he gets to know her.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Grumbling, surprised, converted, treasuring it.
